channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Singapore's Efforts to Boost Birthrates Offer Lessons for the U.S.
item.description: Singapore launched a national plan to address its falling birthrate. Experts see policy ideas relevant to the U.S.

item.title: Russian Jet-Powered Drones Leave Kyiv Shelves Empty and Residents Rattled
item.description: For a fifth day, Russian forces hit Kyiv and surrounding areas, causing empty supermarket shelves and unease.

item.title: Many women receive antibiotics for UTIs they do not actually have
item.description: A study shows that many women treated for recurring UTIs were misdiagnosed, with symptoms stemming from hormonal factors instead.

item.title: U.S.-Venezuela oil deal unlikely to affect gas prices, experts say
item.description: The U.S. announced a deal to develop Venezuela's oil reserves, but energy experts indicate it will not lower domestic gas prices.
